objective: Create the safe PC cleanup audit package. This is design and inventory tooling only: no deletion, no local execution, no paid services. Define a structured audit schema, a discovery procedure, a read-only PowerShell inventory script that can later be run manually on Windows, and an Astra review packet. Update project memory/provenance. The audit script must never delete, uninstall, modify registry, stop services, or alter files.
constraints: No AI video inference on local PC
No cleanup deletion or uninstall actions
PowerShell script must be read-only and output an inventory report only
acceptance_criteria: Audit schema records candidate path, category, evidence signals, confidence, size, last modified time, provenance match, safe-removal status, and review state.
Discovery procedure explicitly distinguishes verified agent-owned artifacts from unknown/user/system artifacts.
PowerShell script performs discovery/inventory only and contains no deletion, uninstall, registry write, service-stop, package-removal, or file-modification commands.
Astra review packet contains objective, artifacts, evidence, risks, open questions, and explicit approval/rejection criteria.
Memory records TASK-0001 as awaiting Astra review.
